entries.title: Do more from any computer that controls your first mate
entries.body: A computer that controls your first mate now shows its Settings, whether or not a window is open beside it: General, Projects, Intelligence, Runbooks, Usage and Integrations. Sign in to a subscription from where you are, and a sign-in page opens in that computer's browser. Each computer keeps its own look and voice.

picture.alt: Settings on a computer that controls a first mate, open at Intelligence, with the AI subscriptions to add and the sections General, Projects, Runbooks, Usage and Integrations in the list.
